title: House of Wilds is now on Google Play
summary: Our first official Android Google Play release is here: Drunk Yeti’s House of Wilds.
imageAlt: Yeti’s Frost Lock, a slot machine hosted by the Yeti in House of Wilds.
body: Drunk Yeti’s House of Wilds is officially available on Google Play. Bring the studio’s wild slots, character-led casino tables, and seven-night reward wheel to your Android device.
Visit the game page for screenshots, the studio trailer, and the browser edition. Google Play has device compatibility, age rating, and current availability.
This is the start of our studio release journal. We’ll use it to share real launches, updates, artwork, and official trailers as they become available.

title: Schmuck Deluxe is now on Google Play
summary: Empty your hand and climb from Schmuck to President in Drunk Yeti Studio’s 3D card game, now available for Android.
imageAlt: A hand of cards in front of the green table in Schmuck Deluxe.
body: Every round can change who sits at the top of the table. Play by Classic rules, make Poker combinations, or try Collection rules as you race to empty your hand.
Practice against AI offline or pass a device around for a local game. Visit Google Play for device compatibility and the current release details.

title: Three Drunk Yeti games on the Microsoft Store
summary: Klay Karts, PenPals: Battle for the Blank, and Yeti Brawl are available for Windows PC.
body: Race through sculpted tracks in Klay Karts, draw your way through puzzles and arenas in PenPals, or take on CPU rivals and friends in Yeti Brawl.
The Windows PC collection links to each game’s Microsoft Store listing and studio game page. Visit the store for current availability and system requirements.

title: What’s in development for Android
summary: Meet five games we’re preparing for Android, from sculpted-track racing to squirrel-powered industry.
body: We’re working on Android editions of Klay Karts, Super Nexus War (Nexus Wars), Chainfall, MANA, and Squirrel Idle Tycoon.

These editions are in development, testing, or release review. Visit our Android page for the lineup and the games you can already install on Google Play. We’ll post individual launch updates as public downloads become available.

title: FindIndieGame lists seven Drunk Yeti games
summary: Seven games have FindIndieGame directory pages, and six received recommendations from Awesome Games Review Group on Steam.
body: FindIndieGame has added directory pages for seven of our games. Its listings cover genres and related games. You can use them to discover everything from Alaskan seafood logistics in Dillingham to hovercraft action in Hover Rancher.
Awesome Games Review Group also posted Steam curator recommendations for MANA, Goat Nuclear Clicker, Squirrel Idle Tycoon, Emu Empire, Space Pinball, and Dillingham.
See the directory pages below or visit our Steam collection for the official store listings.

title: AR3NA: All-Stars and Dillingham: Salmon Run come to the Microsoft Store
summary: Two more Drunk Yeti games are available for Windows through the Microsoft Store.
body: Take the court in AR3NA: All-Stars, a 3D party arena game with modes like Magic Soccer, Sumo, and Capture the Flag.
In Dillingham: Salmon Run, work the docks and keep an Alaskan seafood processing line moving through salmon season. Both games have dedicated Microsoft Store pages with current PC requirements.

title: Klay Karts updates its desktop browser build on itch.io
summary: Race with a keyboard or gamepad and keep your best times in your browser.
body: The updated Klay Karts browser build supports desktop keyboards and standard gamepads. Shape shortcuts in the clay, drift through corners, and chase a faster lap.
Your progress and best times save in the browser you use to play.
